welcomeMessage: Welcome to Legal Justia. Please select a complaint category.

questions.1: Please tell us about the accused's occupation or status
questions.2: Please tell us about your status as well
questions.3: How did you first come to know the accused?
questions.6: How did you decide to receive the service and make payment?
questions.7: What lies did the accused tell you to make you deposit money?
questions.8: How did you arrange the funds?
questions.9: How did you dispose of the property?
questions.10: What made you realize that the accused had been lying?
questions.12: What is your motivation for filing this complaint?
questions.13: Are you pursuing any civil or criminal proceedings related to this case?
questions.14: I will prepare the complaint for you. Please type 'end' when you're ready to receive it.
